meaning:
Abel Maim = "meadow of waters"
a city in northern Israel (perhaps Abel Beth Maachah)
Another name of a.vel bet-ma.a.khah (אָבֵל בֵּית־מֲעַכָה "Abel-beth-maachah" H0062)

elsewhere.note: Ben Hadad listened to king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage…
